title: Stoppage Time S4: maximum graphics and polish (Low, HD, Ultra)
lensAText: a sceptical game art director. Look at every frame the builder cites with the Read tool, then build the standalone page yourself ('npx vite build --config src/onfoot/vite.sportsbar.config.ts --outDir <a scratch folder>') and take your own frames in ONE short Playwright script at 390x844 (DPR 3, isMobile) and 1280x720, on Low, HD and Ultra, day and night, in the bar, at the pool tables and on the patio: judge the look against the S4 brief in PROJECT_OC_SPORTS_BAR.md (is each quality tier a clear, deliberate step up, readable on a phone, free of artefacts, honest labels, our own names) and confirm Lot 57 is unaffected.
brief: Stoppage Time (our own sports bar at the Lopez & Lefty's site, a Sims-like on-foot venue, also mounted inside the main game) phase S4: maximum graphics and polish, Low / HD / Ultra. The full S4 brief, its status line and notes are in PROJECT_OC_SPORTS_BAR.md (read the S4 phase, the 'Status (2026-11-09): S4 built' line and every S4 note) and PROJECT_OC_STYLE_GUIDE.md. HEAD is 5c572f6, a merge of origin/claude/onfoot (Lot 57's P1d maximum-graphics look, whose retro/look modules S4 builds on) made by the first S4 builder on top of origin/claude/sports-bar c76046e (S3b). The first S4 build was REJECTED by both lenses: the code lens found three parts of the brief missing while the logs did not say so; the art lens rejected the look (their full verdicts were lost in the machine reset). A repair was half-done when work paused: its edits are restored on disk. Check EVERY S4 item in the plan, finish the missing ones, fix what is wrong, and say plainly which items are done. Keep: S1-S3b behaviour (needs, ordering, screens, games, crowd, staff, conversations), the honest labels ('Simulated crowd', 'simulated' matches), our own names, no real money; Lot 57 unaffected (no file under src/onfoot/lot57/, src/onfoot/people/ or Lot 57's main.ts/index.html may differ from origin/claude/onfoot); the in-game mount (the live game wraps sportsbar/main.ts in a mount layer later; keep main.ts's exports and release paths intact, and make S4's new look release everything it creates when the venue is left). Cheap on phones (Low is the phone default). PROVE: npx tsc --noEmit; both standalone builds ('npx vite build --config src/onfoot/vite.config.ts' and '--config src/onfoot/vite.sportsbar.config.ts'); the sports bar test groups (node tests/sportsbar.mjs quick groups, tests/sportsbar-s4.mjs and the S2a/S2b/S3b/social tests); frames on Low, HD and Ultra at 1280x720 and 390x844, day and night, at five places (entrance, bar, pool tables, TVs, patio) into tests/out/sportsbar/s4-*.png. Look at every frame. UPDATE 2026-11-11 ~1 PM PT (second pass): the first post-reset pass built and repaired S4 (its notes: PROJECT_OC_PROGRESS.md 2026-11-11, the plan's 'S4's repair' notes and status line, handoff item 18). The code lens KEPT the build; the art lens rejected the look before the repair; the repair then fixed it (Details row of light cones and dust, transitions, performance pass, text size, the freeway light streams that bloomed into fog at night, the over-bright night ceiling, releaseS4 for the mount) but reported done=false only because of items outside this lane: E0 (needs Lot 57's files, off limits: WAIVED here, say so), the owner's open questions O37 and 1-3 (leave open, list them), and the golden-hour frames it had not shot. THIS PASS: keep everything on disk; shoot the golden-hour frames; fix the weak frames it listed where it is cheap and safe (the portrait entrance crops the wordmark; in portrait the HUD covers the top quarter; at Low at night the ceiling over the bar is still pale; the night patio from the fixed camera is mostly dark ground); re-run the S1 'cross' group on HD (it failed once with a closed browser) and any group that was not clean, one at a time; re-run tsc and both builds. Report done=true when the work is ready for review, listing plainly what is waived or left open and why.
